items.title: Generali launching Lloyd’s Syndicate 2031 Red Bridge, to enhance access to reinsurance capital
items.summary: This content is copyright to www.artemis.bm and should not appear anywhere else, or an infringement has occurred. Global re/insurer Generali is the latest to enter the Lloyd’s market with what seems a sidecar-like syndicate as a way to enhance and make its reinsurance arrangements more efficient, while the announcements points to the potential for alternative and capital markets to be involved.
